<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I can create a harquebus that will be able to charge a clockwork shot with explosive force. To make this, I'll need
-A targetian harquebus
-One pneuma
-Two bottles of oily water, or some form of oil
-Two fire salts

</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Your shield seems to have its own power source, and can generate weak blasts of energy with no adverse effects. I think, given the right materials, I can melt the shield down and turn it into a harquebus that keeps the effects, but also generates its own ammunition.
I will need
-A targetian harquebus
-Your shield, please note this will be destroyed during the process!
-Five gold ingots
-Three void salts

</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I've been looking into a harquebus that can utilize the properties of clockwork shots to give it an increased damage output. However, to do this, I'll need the following
-A Dwemer crossbow, one that is not enhanced
-Three gold ingots
-Two Dwemer cogs

</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I've decided to go ahead and make basic Upgate operation user-controlled.
What this means is that you can leave ME alone, and simply use the Upgate to head to predetermined destinations.
To start, you must have an address module, that is, a list of the possible locations you can head to. Put this module in the barrel next to the lever, and when you pull the lever, the Upgate will point to this destination. If you put in more modules, the destination will be randomly selected from one of the possible addresses.

</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
My dearest Captain Undilar,
If you recieve a moment of time to yourself, might I suggest you take a vacation to the southwest of Dawnstar? There you might find a place the locals call "Stonehole Mine", rumored to be haunted. Fear not though, the ghosts inside were recently cleared out, and it would be the perfect spot to head down and contemplate on your place in life! Perhaps take the time to practice your magical skills?
Now, it would be rude of me to suggest you do this alone, so may I also suggest you bring with you your closest compatriots, preferrably ones who are heavily armed, after all the roads are so very dangerous this time of year, who knows what you might encounter.
Truly yours,
A helpful friend

</font>
